title: Manuel Bot Is Terrifying
summary: Revenge game vs Manuel (2100), the strongest chess.com Advanced bot that beat him in his advanced-bot speedrun. Same London opening as before, he deviates with an early Bg3/solid setup, closes the centre with e5, launches h4 and a kingside sacrifice and eventually mates with the queen. Game review afterwards (98.4 accuracy in the opening, dubious middlegame).
